analogy.rationale: IL5 receptor is expressed almost exclusively on eosinophils, which are absent from these cell lines, so IL5 inhibitors should produce little to no transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other immune-signaling inhibitors that also act on pathways poorly represented in these cells.
